blocks.text: Hurayrah the Qur'aan. All praise belongs to Allaah Who has blessed Abu Hurayrah with Muhammad ﷺ. All praise belongs to Allaah Who has fed me leavened bread and given me fine garments to wear. All praise belongs to Allaah Who has given me the hand of Ghazwaan's daughter in marriage after I had been her servant to earn food to fill my belly and now I am able to annoy her just as she used to annoy me. Destruction will come to the Arabs because of the evil that has already arrived. Destruction will come to them because they will be led by mere children who will rule according to their passion and will kill in anger. Glad tidings to you, O non-Arabs! I swear by the Being Who controls my life that even if Deen is suspended on the Pleiades constellation, a group from you will certainly reach it." [^1]

Hadhrat Abu Habeebah narrates that he entered the house of Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) during the period when he was besieged in it. It was then he heard Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) seek permission to address Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA). When permission was granted, Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) stood up, duly praised Allaah and then said, "I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'You will surely encounter plenty of tribulation and disputes after me.' 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ!' someone asked, 'What do you advise us to do?' Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, 'Attach yourselves with the Ameer and those with him.'" Saying this, Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) pointed towards Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA). [^2]
A Lecture of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Salaam (RA)

Hadhrat Muhammad bin Yusuf bin Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Salaam reports that he once sought permission to see Hajjaaj bin Yusuf and when permission was granted, he entered and greeted with Salaam. Hajjaaj instructed two men sitting close to his chair to make way and when they did, Hadhrat Muhammad bin Yusuf sat down. Hajjaaj then said to him, "May Allaah grant abundant good to your father. Do you know the narration that your father reported to Abdul Malik bin Marwaan, which he heard from your grandfather Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Salaam (RA)?" "May Allaah have mercy on you," Hadhrat Muhammad bin Yusuf remarked, "there are so many narrations. Which one is it?" Hajjaaj replied, "The narration of the Egyptians when they blockaded the house of Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)."
Hadhrat Muhammad bin Yusuf then said, "I know that narration. When Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) was besieged in his house, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Salaam (RA) arrived and entered the house. The people gave him way until he came to Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) and said, 'Peace be on you, O Ameerul Mu'mineen!' 'Peace be on you too,' Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) replied, 'What brings you here, O Abdullaah bin Salaam?' Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Salaam (RA) replied, 'I have come to remain by your side (and to fight these people) until I am either martyred or until Allaah grants you victory because I estimate that these people will definitely come out to fight you.
